title: Standard settings with a random-lesion reference (van den Heuvel 2026)
differences_from_source: The source compared published lesion network maps with maps of randomly placed lesions; here the reference is this library's pooled exact relocation null of the cohort (rl_independent: each lesion relocated independently in the brain, 20 relocations per lesion, 1000 null cohorts).
The similarity of the maps to connectome degree and PC1 is reported with the lnm-reference-v1 reference maps of the chosen connectome.
Specificity uses this library's permutation GLM with a lesion-volume covariate.
description: Group results on mean Fz maps, reported against a random-lesion (relocation) null, the degree/PC1 QA and a threshold and connectome robustness sweep.
